verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks handles payroll and W-4/withholding data collection, and multi-state pay is supported (justworks-docs-7, justworks-docs-21), implying tax withholding is managed as part of payroll processing. However, no direct documentation explicitly describes automatic calculation, filing, and remittance of federal/state/local payroll taxes as a distinct guaranteed service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic tax filing/remittance process, confirmation of local tax handling, and any independent/third-party verification of tax compliance accuracy.
